Method of Attack: Data theft targeting credentials from web browsers, browser extensions, Steam, Telegram, and cryptocurrency wallets
Exfiltration of system data to command & control (C2) servers

Binary protocol over TCP for C2 communication
Indicators of Compromise: Server-hosting IP addresses in France, Germany, Russia, the United States, China, Latvia, and Bulgaria
